title: Absolutely great value
text:
These clusters are so full and have a great curl. The only problem I had was there are short pieces of band that stick out on each side of the clusters. I used some small scissors to cut them off because they felt stiff and I didn't won't to worry about that feeling uncomfortable on my lash line. I only needed 4 cluster per eye. I worked from the outer corner inward (under my lash line) and the space left was not big enough for a whole cluster. You could probably cut these in half but I already had some individual clusters on hand so I used 2 to fill in that space. Overall, definitely a great purchase even with the slight modification I had to make.

Update: Changed from 4 to 3 stars because I had to remove them the next day because the band was causing too much discomfort for longer wear. If you plan on wearing these on top of the lash line, it's still a good purchase however, if your going to use the under the lash line technique, like how I prefer to, you might want to skip these. The band part is a little too stiff for that area. If the segments were a little shorter, more like a cluster lash, it might be more comfortable... but the length and the stiffness make it so it doesn't conform to the curve of the lash line and starts to feel like it's poking into the skin.

title: GREAT nozzle perfect for watering plants, washing vehicles and washing down siding or spraying off the porch
text:
I am genuinely impressed with this quality hose nozzle. As a home owner in the Midwest with several BIG dogs and an avid gardener (but disabled now so my gardens... well.. don't get as much attention as I wish I could provide... ) and vehicles and siding to wash, I KNOW the value of a quality built garden hose nozzle / sprayer. I LOVE the ease and convenience of this nozzle! It fit right onto my heavy duty garden hose with standard fittings. The included washer is PERFECT, not a cheap hard plastic version, so NO LEAKS !! That is a priority for me !!!

The nozzle fits well into my hand allowing ease of use without causing undo cramping even when using for an extended period of time. Someone paid attention to ALL the finer details on this nozzle, the spray patterns range from high pressure to a fine mist so I can go from hosing down the garage floor or driveway to another setting to wash the car to another setting to use a fine mist on my potted plants without spraying the dirt out everywhere. My husband has restricted use of his hand, he was also able to easily use this nozzle once connected to the hose. 5 GOLD STARS for being made well enough he can use the nozzle !!

This nozzle was provided free of charge for reviewing purposes. This is my honest viewpoint after evaluating and using this garden hose nozzle around my home, my vehicles and my gardens. It arrived just in time during the fall cleanup around my home. The spiders had built a number of webs and the leaves were entangled, this nozzle made quick work of the effort to knock them down washing the 8 legged creatures away so I could set out several much larger fake spiders for tonight's Trick or Treaters!

title: Ingredients identical to Dr. Bronner's liquid soap, but price is double or higher
text:
So, this product is natural and works well to clean brushes. It is a super basic soap without unwanted chemicals, which is great. However, the ingredients are pretty much identical to Dr. Bronner's Pure Castille Liquid Soap, which costs half as much or less, and does the exact same thing. Dr. B's also comes in numerous scents (all organic) and even unscented. Also, I think Dr. B's is more concentrated, so it takes less soap to clean each brush, making it even more economical.

Bottom line, this "Makeup Brush Cleansing Shampoo" is a perfectly good product, but you can get essentially the same thing for a much lower price by buying Dr. Bronner's Liquid Soap instead.

text: I have to admit that I am uncomfortable with change, but when a product works so well, why try anything else?  I started using Pantene in college, and I am still using it 25+ years later.  It has changed over the years, so I have gone with the flow by choosing the specific product for my hair type.  I have very long (to my waist), very thick, somewhat coarse hair that is starting to gray a tad.  All of those issues can be real problems for hair products, but Pantene has always been great for me.  I don't go to the salon often, but every time I do, the stylist is highly impressed by the health and shine in my hair.  I have next to no damage, so split ends and friz are a non-issue.  One bit of advice, though, is that I do use the shampoo plus conditioner product THEN I use the conditioner product as well.  You just have to find what works for your hair.

This is really a very unique travel/gift set. The items included truly make it handy when traveling and the items are not typically found bundled together. There are a few items that I really wanted. A) It has a glass nail file with a carrying case. This glass file is very nice and they last for such a long time that this item alone was worth the set. What I really like about a crystal/glass nail file is that you can clean and sanitize it. Besides maintaining its use for much longer periods than regular nail files, the fact that I can clean this is a huge bonus for me. B) The travel perfume atomizer. This is just fantastic for travel/storing in a small bag, etc... it is super simple to fill (fill from the bottom if you've never used one before and can be confusing at first) and there is no need to carry around a full bottle of my favorite perfume. There is a small window so that you can easily identify when it is time to refill. The tweezers set with a built in light is actually very nice. It is comfortable to hold/use and the light is useful. Now these may not end up being your "go-to" tweezers for eyebrow maintenance but they are a fairly good set. The make up brush is a good quality as well and stores away without leaving/getting make up in your purse. As someone that is not typically a fan of 'gift sets', I will say that this is a very nice set.The fact that the items are not typically seen bundled together, makes it one I would enjoy giving as a gift

I received this item at not cost for testing. All opinions are my own.

text:
These clusters are so full and have a great curl. The only problem I had was there are short pieces of band that stick out on each side of the clusters. You could probably cut these in half but I already had some individual clusters on hand so I used 2 to fill in that space. Overall, definitely a great purchase even with the slight modification I had to make.

Update: Changed from 4 to 3 stars because I had to remove them the next day because the band was causing too much discomfort for longer wear. If you plan on wearing these on top of the lash line, it's still a good purchase however, if your going to use the under the lash line technique, like how I prefer to, you might want to skip these. The band part is a little too stiff for that area. If the segments were a little shorter, more like a cluster lash, it might be more comfortable... but the length and the stiffness make it so it doesn't conform to the curve of the lash line and starts to feel like it's poking into the skin.

title: Much better than expected!
text:
I bought this at a discount store, not on Amazon, but decided to review it since it doesn't have a lot of reviews. It cost me about $9, which is why I bought it. I was just starting a k-beauty routine and picked this out totally randomly, simply because I knew I needed a night cream and I liked the ingredients.

I liked a lot of things about it--how it feels thick and creamy, yet cooling, and it soaks right into my skin and doesn't leave it feeling oily like many other products do. I have dehydrated skin (live in the desert, at high altitude), but it also still gets oily at times. I like how this soaks into my skin and does not make it feel oily, even though I put it on as my final night step after several other treatments and essences.

But because I'm new to the whole system and trying several different products at once, I didn't realize quite how good this was. I thought, yeah, feels nice, not greasy, but otherwise unimpressive. But then I had surgery and wasn't following all the k-beauty steps as much as I had been, and particularly been not using this and I realized....wow, this stuff is actually pretty good. It was THIS cream that has been giving my skin such a silky feel! And I certainly noticed it when I wasn't using it--my skin didn't feel nearly as good, and I'd only been using it for a few weeks. So, guess I'm sol--it's really nice, at least as part of a multi-treatment skin care routine. I'm going to buy it again when I finish this pot. I do go through it fairly quickly, but I'm also putting it on my neck and hands, and it's not that expensive and really is a nice cream.

title: Suprised - It Doesn't Leak and Has Good Flow
text:
So, when you get this you will notice this strange, black plastic thing threaded into the base of the handle. It looks like a quick connect to a power washer, so don't toss it out. Grab some pliers and give it a quick turn and you can unthread it. Make sure to see the black washer. I didn't since it was compressed on top of the black plastic. Let's say, that without a washer in the handle, you may be very, very underwhelmed by the no-leak capability. Let's say further, that it will spray in every direction and potentially get you soaked.

So, after you make sure to have the washer (or your own) in the handle, that attached hose connection does not leak. So, common issue one - a non issue with this product.

I typically don't plan out my sprayer purchases and pick up a 5-8 dollar one from THD, Menards or Ace without concern. They typically last a season and usually have a decent flow.

This NT01 is pricier than those 'bin' purchases - about 2 to 3 times as much. So, is it worth it? I doubted it, but I like it so far. I will say that I am underwhelmed with the "soak" setting. It just gushes out as soon as it leaves the nozzle. There is no distance so be prepared as you may be the one to get soaked.

The rest of the settings are great and the "flat" shoots across my yard. I've not had that power in a hose/nozzle before and I already cannot wait until next summer when the kids are playing outside. They won't see it coming.

In all seriousness, I can give a drink to all my bushes and trees in my front yard without having to unroll the hose. That's living. Of course, for gentle watering I'll have to get a bit closer and use another setting.

I declined the vendor's first offer for a free nozzle to evaluate. I agreed to the second request and I now admit that the big box store cheap nozzle is not going to be the best. Luckily, my wife never reads these posts.

The company sent a promotional sample for evaluation without promise of a review.

Unfortunately my unit must have some bad threads on it. I could not connect it to a hose properly... hopefully and probably a fluke, but giving it 3 stars for now. I'll ask for a replacement and update the review if I receive one.

UPDATE 2015-11-05: I received a replacement unit and didn't have any problems getting it on the hose this time. I did have to remove the black plastic piece that was already attached to the nozzle, and had to use a wrench because my hand wasn't strong enough to turn it. When it came out I noticed that the rubber washer was stuck to it so I had to put it back into the nozzle, then I attached the hose. The unit works very well. The only thing I noticed was that it is not a high volume nozzle (doesn't put out a lot of water but most people probably wouldn't want it to anyway). I'm revising my review to 4.5 stars and rounding up to 5.

NOTE: I was sent a free product sample for review. I was not paid or told what to write.

Listed in it's ingredients is a mixture of Palm oils that are from certified growers of this product, and it contains Shea Butter that helps keep the skin moisturized, and Argan oil that's good for a comfortable and soft feel on the skin.  The citrusy Bergamot and sharp Lavender flowery scent hung on for a while.  It should be great for either sex, with that nice pure and clean smell.  This bar fits comfortably in the hand, and should last for some time, as it's a good sturdy and hard soap.

title: Love it, with a few conditions
text:
Okay, I've got crazy sensitive skin and basically can't use any antiperspirant and many natural deodorants without having a reaction. I've tried at least 20 different brands- Tom's, Herban Cowboy, Lume, Weleda- and I've tried roll-ons, sticks, creams, powders, you name it. I work up a sweat at work every day and unfortunately for me and my laundry basket, I can be a stinky person. This is one of my favorite natural deodorants I've tried, but it does have some drawbacks:

Pros:
1. Smells delightful. It is an earthy, aromatheraputic type scent (not perfumey). If you like Aveda products you'll like how this smells. And an extra pro, the smell is not overwhelming- I can't even smell it when it's on unless I smell my armpit directly. Nice!
2. Good staying power. Unlike most roll-ons I've tried, it dries quickly and at the end of the day I can still smell it if I smell my armpit. I do smell some sweat, too, but it doesn't smell like b.o. Nice!
3. No bad skin reactions after 2 months of use. First product I've used in YEARS that I got away with using this long. Very nice!
4. Washes out of fabrics. Some other essential oil type deo's I've used in the past have left oil marks on the armpits of my shirts. I've had no issues with this product. We love it!
Cons:
1. Pricier than a lot of other brands. I've been using it as recommended, morning and evening, for about 7 weeks, and I have about 1/5 left of the bottle.
2. Like every other roll-on, does nothing to soothe chafing if you're wearing a tank or t shirt or you move around a lot.
3. On hot, busy days, a midday reapplication goes a long way. I don't have time/access to do this at my work, so some days I just get stinky. But I will say, I don't get as stinky as I have with a lot of other products.

Bottom line, I'll buy it again so I don't run out, but I'm still on the hunt for the *just right* one for me. Overall, 8/10. Tics most boxes for me, and the scent is really lovely.

text:

I tried DEO 46 as I am a fan of Neroli. The scent is more complex than I expected, you can feel neroli and floral notes, but it also has woody scent from the deep. I inhale the aroma before applying the deodorant, and I love it. And it is not overpowering, which is important for me.

I decided to try DEO 97 when I still have the previous one :) This one is also very complex, definitely woody notes are more intense. But menthol and citrus still manages to keep it fresh, and I believe it provides more odor protection since citrus essential oils are very powerful against bacteria.

I still have not tried DEO 12, but soon I will.

title: Anytime you need extra moisture or after washing your face entirely
text: I purchased this facial mist for long days at work. I am going back to work soon and there will be 12 hour days in the jail. I know, some will be thinking it's an aerosol can though. Well I've been doing my job for the environment and haven't ever used aerosol plus, it's easier for me to spray since I have weaker hands due to Multiple Sclerosis. The spray is light and refreshing. Many pumps are too harsh when they are pumped. Can you imagine it hitting your face and it comes out with bigger drops than needed, leaving runs in your makeup? Aerosol spray is very light. Plus, the aerosol can keeps the product hygienic. There isn't any way that fine particles can get into the product and contaminate it. Just enough to freshen up my moisturizer at work. Or to spritz my face and reapply my moisturizer. I'm almost 41 years old and I pride myself on taking care of the skin on my face. I don't wear makeup but I've done some research and I read this product is just enough to help freshen up your makeup so it doesn't become flaky. The bottle is about 7" tall and about an inch around. Fits perfectly in my work bag. It has witch hazel for toning your skin and hyaluronic acid/collagen for plumping the skin. Rose water helps to get rid of any redness and irritation. If you need to know how much 100 ml is, it is almost 4 oz. 1 oz is the size of a serum bottle that you apply by dropper after washing your face. This spray contains almost 4 of those bottles. This is the best anti-wrinkle facial mist.

text: I am not sure about this product. The problem is my scalp is greasy to which I have to wash it every day. Then I decided to try Monat, because apparently it was supposed to fix the grease problem. After a little bit of time of using it, I developed psoriasis dermatitis. I had to get prescription medication to get rid of it. I stopped using Monat and I've been on the hunt ever since to get my hair back to normal. I stumbled across Truss a month ago. It is working great. I can go 3 days without washing my hair. But now my hair has started falling out at the root! I am not sure if its the shampoo or if it is long term side effects from covid (i have done extensive research and many ppl have experienced hair loss months after recovering, which makes sense for me because I have other long term side effects from covid). So I am not sure what to do at this point. My thick hair is thinning and im afraid to make any more changes to my hair. I am not sure if my hair is being stripped of its natural oils and my scalp is reacting, or if its non related to this shampoo. Nevertheless, it works i guess? No more daily grease but i could be going bald. Id rather have my greasy hair back and have to wash it daily than this. Good luck if you decide to use this product.  Theres a lot of great reviews so thats what made me decide to try it. Im giving 3 stars because its hard to determine how to rate my experience.

title: Super Finicky, Super Sticky
text: I bought this because I wanted to try FX grade gelatin for its strength and durability rather than use my homemade mixes and risk it melting under theatrical lights or tearing etc. The cubes are smaller than I expected but that was fine for my small prosthetics. First off the gelatin takes hours to set firm. I recommend refrigerating your pieces if you can. Yet even after a night in the fridge the piece was extremely sticky, very delicate and some parts were just plain gummy and not set at all. This can happen if the gelatin is boiled as that breaks down the chemicals. On the second try I took care to not let it boil at all, same result. The only pro is that it takes color tint very well. A bit of creme make up will do the trick. Make your own gelatin at home for the same price. Mines not sticky, it sets fast and decently durable. I will be trying other brands of fx cubes as well.

title: My dermatologist is fired!
text: I suffer from horrible eczema on my hands. Mainly due to the fact that I’m OCD and wash them way too often and with harsh soap and very hot water. They also get really bad in the winter months when it’s colder outside. My hand lotion drawer up until finding this product looked like I had robbed a CVS. I LITERALLY have bought every hand lotion on the market. I have blown $100’s of dollars trying to find a solution. I’ve also tried a handful of very expensive prescription lotion recommended by my dermatologist. Not only did they not help they were incredibly greasy and could only be used at bedtime. After hours of internet research I came across this stuff. Tried it once and will never look back. My biggest problem was even products like Aveeno would sting my skin really badly after applying. This has no sting. It is nice and thick but not too thick that you can’t still do things afterwards like write with a pen or text. If you put a lot on at night and cover them with cotton gloves they really work their magic overnight. Mine were so chapped this past winter I was in physical pain. It hurt for water to run over my hands. Two nights of using this with gloves and my hands were back to normal. Highly recommend for anyone that has super sensitive skin, eczema or raw and chapped hands from OCD.

title: I missed my banana clips!
text:
I have a banana clip!!! I was feeling nostalgic. I lived in banana clips from like 17 - 20. They're awesome because it's like spreading the base of a pony tale from the top to the bottom of your head giving a pony mane effect. They're perfect for curly hair.

I'm fifty, if you used to wear them like me you'll remember there were two sizes. These are the longer size. It was funny that when I opened the package I immediately looked for which end had the wide piece and which had the little ball hinge. These are crappy cheap versions of what I remember. They're very difficult to open. I filed down the little nub on the opening end with a nail file and that helped. Having said that, I love them!

I've been working from home during lockdown for a year and usually have a scrunchie on top my head or a butterfly clip in the back. My new banana clip is so much more comfortable. I will be wearing one in my Zoom meeting tomorrow.

title: Glowsome!
text: I have been using this mask at least twice a week for the past three months, and I cannot get enough of it. It feels amazing upon application, dries pretty quick, and has a nice and subtle natural scent to it. I prefer to roll it off, rather than wash it off, which is something that I have not seen before it any other mask. It seems to exfoliate and moisturize my face at the same time, which is super impressive. It doesn’t have that drying effect like a clay mask would, and doesn’t leave a tacky residue like some of the moisturizing masks, so it’s a perfect compromise. So far I’ve definitely noticed my pores are less apparent, the tone of my face is more even and I have that subtle glow without the added oiliness. I’ve gotten numerous compliments about my skin. 10/10, would recommend.

title: Awesome value and great selection of scents!
text:
With (6) one ounce jars to sample from the value here is really amazing considering you get six different scents to try.

It’s hard to pull the trigger on a single full-size jar just based on the descriptions of what the ingredients are so a sampler is very appreciated.

The 1 ounce jars will actually last quite a while if you’re using the proper amount of beard butter, which isn’t very much per application, so it’s not like these are one or two use jars either.

When you go by the scent profiles alone it’s hard to pull the trigger on a full size jar if you’re not quite sure what it’s gonna smell like in your beard. Just based off the scent profiles I would’ve ordered jars that I wasn’t 100% pleased after receiving them with but the sampler took away that risk.

For instance based on the scent profile I never would have ordered the “Corktown” scent because one of the scents in that profile is tobacco and that doesn’t seem like something I would like but Corktown is by far my favorite of the entire set and I will be ordering a full size jar straight away.

Detroit grooming is top quality stuff and the sampler is a very affordable way to take the guesswork out of what you should be buying next in full size.

The only negative I would give this sampler is there is no scent profile included on the jars or on the box so in order to find out what each scent profile is you either need to go to their website or look up the full size jars on Amazon and look at the pictures as the full size jars have the scent profile on the label. Not a big deal as it just takes a minute or two but if the scent profiles were included with the sampler that would save you a step.

title: Not the original midnight cologne
text:
This is not the same product that was originally called midnight that came in the blue glass bottle with the silver plate. I assumed that the bottle was just changed to be more economical since it has the same name by the same manufacturer.

I am only 1 day in so far but it already doesn’t seem to last as long as the original midnight cologne I have been referencing. I did 3 squirts like usual and this wasn’t even in the morning time like traditionally. I received the package mid day so since I was out of cologne I decided to put some on immediately. It went on strong at first and after 4-5 hours it died down immensely. This can vary since shirt fabric can affect it and this is only day one but we will see.
This bottle also sprays more per squirt compaired to the the original midnight bottle it seems since I could feel the dampness on my shirt in each area which after using a whole bottle of of the previous cologne I feel like I would have noticed that.
If bath and body works wants to discontinue midnight then fine. But don’t reuse the name without adding a 2 at the end of it so people know.

title: Highly Recommend!!!!  Beautiful Golden Tan, Easy Application, Use the Mitt!
text: Fantastic fake tanner!  I'm not a fake tanning expert (I used to tan in beds regularly), but I really do my research.  I've tried a couple other self-tanners that I like, all of them fairly inexpensive like this, and this one takes the cake.  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND using the mitt or getting the mitt.  I know a lot of reviewers said the gloves work great, but the mitt really helps even out the application process and keep the tint looking more even for instant wear (sometimes I put it on in the morning/midday!).  Plus, the mitt keeps excess color off of your hands and the mitt is very soft, almost a silky microfiber finish.  (I was using a foam mitt before, and this mitt is MUCH nicer and easy to clean.)  I also prefer to take a shower later in the day or the next day to rinse off the tint, because the tint itself will come off with water.  Underneath the tint is that beautiful golden glow, which looks very natural - not orangey or anything like that - and does not bleed any color when exposed to water!  It looks great on the face, too - just a good as when I was bed tanning.  I've received several compliments already on my "tan" and have been using only a few weeks.  I think I might get the dark or ultra dark shade for my legs, since the color seems to fade a smidgeon faster with shaving (i.e. heavy exfoliation, which makes total sense) and legs tend to tan a little darker naturally anyways.  I recommend applying every 2-3 days to maintain color, depending on often you shower/exfoliate shave.  Please note I'm also very fair with naturally ash blond hair, and Medium is perfect for fair skin.  It also has a slight odor to me when applying/prior to rinse, but it's not necessarily unpleasant or very noticeable.

title: Just what a natural loofah is supposed to be!
text:
I’ve been using natural fiber loofahs (not the plastic kind) off and on since 2010. By nature there is some variation, depending on the size of the underlying plant, the way it’s made/grown, any bleaching, softening or other treatments applied that may change the texture. This is GREAT value for three medium-to-small sized natural loofahs.

The first time you use it you gotta soak it in warm water to puff up (it will turn into an oval cylinder, rather than staying like a flat pad) and release its seeds. I didn’t find the seed quantity to be gross or unreasonable, though it’s definitely different than most natural loofahs you’ll buy in a drugstore or Whole Foods, say—those tend to be treated and at least prewashed, to remove the seeds etc.

The smell: I have a super sensitive nose. Just speaking for the item I received, this is 100% “normal loofah smell” —a little grassy, kind of like dried clean straw that’s been dampened again—with a bit of a smoky smell. It’s not offensively smoky. Like a lot less than most whiskey. No “funk,” though the natural loofah herbaceous-ness does get stronger when it’s wet.

I didn’t find this too scratchy at all—in fact, by the time I’d finished soaking out the seeds I found it a little soft for my liking. To be fair I do drybrush about once a week, so I’m used to a good scrub. But if you know what a “normal store-bought loofah” feels like, this is no scratchier than that. If you have super sensitive skin, try using this after it’s soaked in a bowl or tub of hot(!) water for 10 min or so, with some emollient body wash like Aveenk.

title: Electrolysis ain't easy but it works
text:
I'm giving this product a five star review because it actually does work. It might not be working consistently or easily for many users because electrolysis is actually pretty hard to do. That's why there are professionals who do it full time as a job. This product uses galvanic electrolysis. There are two other types that professional users and equipment can do. However if people are patient and follow through with good technique they will get good results eventually. And electrolysis is the ONLY permanent method of hair removal that you can do on your own. Anything else, however easy and painless, is just a temporary fix. So the product should not be judged by how difficult it is to use, but by the permanence of the results.
-Hair grows in three phases. Electrolysis only works best in the initial growing phase and sometimes works in the intermediate phase. It will not work in the final, dormant stage because the root, which electrolysis kills, is not active. An easy way to make sure you are only spending time on hairs in the growing phases is to shave an area and wait a few days. The hairs that poke up are growing.
-It only makes sense to do electrolysis on terminal hairs. Those are the dark, coarse hairs. Vellus hairs, the light and fine ones, are not that compatible with electrolysis because the holes they grow out of are small like the hairs themselves and aren't very easy to thread the needle in to all the way. There's also a risk of scarring. So don't go nuts. Just focus on the terminal hairs.
-Electrolysis kills hair roots through a combination of heat and a corrosive, lye-like substance that results from the electric charge coming in to contact with biological cells. That white, yucky substance that people are complaining about? that's the "lye". Don't wipe it off and don't pluck the hairs right away. You want to let them soak in it a while and die. I treat a hair and then go brush my teeth or water the plants before I pluck the hair. The "lye" needs a few minutes to do the job of killing the hair root.
-You need to actually make contact with all of the root area and the sides at the follicle base to kill it. A hair root is sort of an elongated sheath shape not a little pin dot. If any cells survive it regenerates from the surviving cells. It's a good idea to sort of plunge the needle in and out very, very gently or jiggle it a bit side to side while treating a hair. This increases the area the electricity comes in contact with and improves the odds of killing all the root. It's better than holding the needle perfectly still.
-If you've killed the root the hair will slide out without any tugging and will feel almost "greasy". If you need any force to pull it out it's not dead and you should leave the hair in and wait a few days and try again.
-As you might be able to tell from my comments this is a pretty tricky process and the odds are against you. You need to hit the root perfectly, kill the whole root area and get it in the early phases of growth. I think electrolysis only really works well for targeting a few "crazy" hairs growing in weird spots. It's not that great for clearing large areas. Doing it requires focus and precision. And also a bit of luck. I had a half dozen weird hairs and I've used this product to kill them and am rid of them forever. For that, I consider it priceless. But if you are aiming to use it to clear large areas it's likely it will be a source of frustration. Even for professionals, with professional grade equipment and years of experience, clearing a large area takes months and months of detail oriented work.

title: Slow process, but good results
text:
I was nervous about getting this. There are SO MANY models and brands and reviews out there that I finally decided on one that was within my price range to try, but also had decent reviews. I've had this now for about 4 months and have not had any re-growth of the hairs I've taken out. That's what I was looking for - lasting results. That being said, it is tricky to get used to doing this. It's best if you have someone doing it for you. There are a couple of things to keep in mind: 1. You go one hair at a time, and each one took me about 3-4 minutes, and the instructions say not to do more than a square inch of skin at a time. So depending on how much of an area you want to do, and how dense the hair is it may take months and months to clear a significant area, and that's if you do it every other day. 2.) You will have unsightly sores. You are penetrating your epidermis and electrocuting the hair follicle, so you will get a scab on each pore you zap. I used the Tea Tree lotion they recommend on Amazon and it seemed to work fine. I don't know if it would have been the same without the oil. My scabs were there the same amount of time any other scab I've had has been on me - about a week.

So it's slow going and leaves scabs, but once the scabs went away my hair has not come back at all. It's been great that way! I'm really glad I bought it. The reasons I didn't give five stars is because it said, "Clean and Easy". It's not easy, and when something leaves you scabbed over, that doesn't scream "clean" to me. The other reason is because I had to zap each follicle twice on the highest setting before it worked. But I gave it four stars because it did work! So for the price, and once you get used to it, and if you have a way to hide the scabs for a week, then it's great. I'm happy with the results, which for me is the bottom line.

title: So far so awesome: Day 1
text:
Notes out of the box;
* Very nice, low profile footprint design.
* 7 inches long, 5 inches at widest part of the oval, 2.5 inches tall.
* Fits up to .75 oz polishes with all shaped bottle necks (bam! take that iZen Pro!)
* Silver plastic, no idea on solvent resistance (yet).
* Uses both AC adapter or batteries for cordless operation.
* 5600 shakes per minute promises the box and spec detail.
* 3 detachable, adjustable rubber securing straps.
* 1 on/off button, with a lighter pressure 'pulse on' feature.

Operation:
* Cinch to strap on.
* Pretty impressive agitation for one so wee.
* Noise level mild especially in comparison to my incessant bottle agitation whining. "Ow! My arms! Blah, blah, blah." I'd be more specific, but I was operating it right on a stainless steel counter to put it through the noise test. It'd be unladylike to compare it to a 'personal massager' out loud wouldn't it? Did I just type that? Oopsy, my bad. Quieter over a mat, silicone, towel or cork tile by miles. I did that too.

Result:
Before had separation, some streaky clearness and clinging pigment near the neck. I gave it my regular human powered roll/tap/roll for the following 'before shaker' application demo. (See posted pics)

Left, regular human agitation. 5 freaky coats and I had to wrangle dual directions and mucho smoothing in application. I tried really hard to give it more care actually because I wanted to be ungenerous to ForPro. But, human agitation was a streaky, bubbled shrink-back, difficult, wrinkling mess at every application and cure. Just like last time I dared to be decadent. I purposefully used a problem child color of an otherwise fabulous gel polish line. Plus, I left the cleansing paper towel wipes in the photos to demonstrate the horrid vs acceptable cure difference. Like eww! That's dangerous. It even wiped off in spots!

Right, ForPro shaken. 3 coats. Application was easy and like normally behaved other vampy, dark, well agitated gel polishes. Say what? I thought I'd see some improvement, but I didn't really expect this great of one. The color is wearable and I like it now.

All things are equal in my test, except I was more careful in application of the human shaken swatch, which has 2 more coats for a subpar, unusable result. I had to, it was having a tantrum in streaky pants before ForPro.

Other notes:
ForPro requires a phillips head screwdriver to open the 4 AA battery housing. Probably because it shakes so much? Still, a nice cordless option to the AC adapter also included. Yay that. *Batteries not included.

And, I think any warranty would be online via ForPro website only? This didn't come with instructions or warranty card in the box. Mostly a no-brainer plug and play.

It's unscathed by alcohol meaning any gel polish mishaps can wipe right off. I blotted the underbelly to remove dust lightly.

Clear rubber feet stay put while leaving no marks. That's awesome. Especially compared to Robarts that jiggle off tables and sound like landscaping machines.

I like ForPro so far. I think it saves product and my shake stress physiology. Prettier result in fewer, easier coats :).

It did a good job on both a chunky glitter and a streak-prone frost in a conventional lacquer brand. I did shake them once to break surface tension first though. I also rotated the bottles and let them shake twice. The beads were rolling free in both and additive distribution was even and good after. Thanks ForPro! Please last an eon now.

title: Great solution to keeping my pierced ears open.
text: I’d stopped wearing earrings for about 6 months for no real reason other than I didn’t have to hunt for a pair in the morning.  When I started wearing earrings again I noticed how It was a bit uncomfortable to put them in and as the day wore my ears were sore and irritated.  My piercing were starting to heal and close.  I ordered these to keep my pierced ears open and to enlarge the holes back to normal. They were perfect. I was able to shower, sleep, and wear them 24/7 for 6 weeks straight. I never removed them and cleaned my ears daily with alcohol to prevent any infection.  I made sure to turn them regularly too as my piercings got back to normal. It worked like a charm and my ear piercings are healthy again. I appreciated that the earrings were separated into individual sterile packages. The earring backs also locked into place and made it so the posts didn’t poke you as you slept on your side. I have very sensitive ears and can only wear gold, sterling silver, and surgical steel earrings. These studs didn’t cause me any irritation what so ever.  The only discomfort I felt was from forcing them initially into my ears as the holes had gotten smaller and then the ensuing soreness as the holes stretched open to normal size again. I only needed to use one pair.  The extra pairs are nice in case I ever need them or lose one.  Now, if I decide not to wear one of my nice pairs of earrings for the day, I wear these studs instead as they look nice and go with everything.  I even still sleep in them regularly as they are so comfortable I forget I’m wearing them. Two thumbs up from this girl with pierced ears.

title: I was pleasantly surprised
text:
[[VIDEOID:196aee9ee5552fd2737b70d726cb32cc]] I bought this as an electric shaver for my legs. I'm black and have coarser hair and I think it worked well. It's not as close as a razor but to the naked eye you can't tell. It kind of feels like the stubble from a day old shave. But like I said I was impressed. You do have to go over an area several times but it didn't bother me.

There was no discomfort. There were only a couple times when it seemed to catch and the pinch was very minor. I used large circular or long sweeping motions and it was like getting a leg massage. You can do it while watching tv. I shaved on dry legs (which were extremely ashy so don't judge me) but I want to try it in the shower since it claims to be waterproof. I also love the attachments. I used the trimmer blade to do my bikini area.

The only drawbacks are A) The housing for the blades is hard to open to for cleaning, especially the middle blade. You have to twist it counterclockwise and lift. It's also hard to put back in place. B) The instructions for removing the attachments isn't clear. I was scared I was going to break the thing trying to get them off the unit (turns out you just pull them out with a little force and pop them in, no twisting).

All in all for $20, I would definitely recommend.

text: I bought this to replace my older Norelco 965RX which can no longer hold charge. For the price, it is certainly look and feel a lot cheaper than my 10+ years 965RX. The head is also all plastic with no adjustment (except for the steel blades and combs) unlike the all metal of the old. The head is definitely flexing more than the old but I am not sure if it really cut any closer than the old "Lift and Cut" blades. title: Started great but went down in experience
text:
If you are expecting Shave which is closer to Blade then stop. No Rotary Shaver will ever will do that. I have used Rotary Shavers for last 20 years for beard and I purchased this product with those expectations only. I bought this product for its high ratings, 5 blades vs 4 blades and digital display for battery life. I bought it for my head not face. I still use my Norelco for Beard and quite happy with it.

It started pretty good and deserved all the high ratings when I started using it new.

5 Blades seem better than four but now I feel four is more practical. It is pain to open blades for cleaning. I can still manage outer four with little effort but middle on is pain in fingers. You are supposed to push outer blades backwards and open those first and then rotate middle one counter clock wise to open it but there is no grip to do that. It is just too small and flushed with bottom surface. Same happens when you try to put it back after cleaning. Guys stick with 4 blades

Battery: This is where it let me down after 2.5 months of use. Battery and its digital display worked just fine for a month and a half and then out of blue it went from 30% to 9% in the middle of shave. Then after a few days I turned off shaver after use with battery level of 27% and couple of days later it won't turn on and forced me to charge. You cannot use this shaver plugged in so if battery dies on you you would need about an hour before you can use it again. I wish I had that luxury in morning.

Now after 2.5 months of use I can hear freshly washed/cleaned shaver struggling even in air. Doesn't look like it will last very long.

I feel that I didn't get the worth of money I spent on this product.

title: Great starter lamp for people getting into gel polish.
text:
Why all the hate and bad reviews? This lamp is the price of a Chipotle burrito (for context). This is basically the same lamp that comes with the Madam Glam Gel Kit (which costs $35 if you buy it separately on Madam Glam, this one just doesn't have the cute designs on it).

I wanted to make sure I liked the gel polish system but I didn't want to spend a ton of money on a lamp until I knew I liked the gel system. This is nothing fancy: turn it on, it lights up for 60 seconds then turns off (30 seconds will be nice but that's what your phone timer is for). USB powered so the short cord is a non-issue for me (always close to a computer and you can use your portable cell phone battery charger to power this). It's small, but I have small hands so no big deal. You can't get your whole hand in there, but it do both my thumbs last. The polish cures in 30-60 seconds (depends on what your polish says), works as advertised.

The short cord and the small sized are its weak points, but the price makes up for all that and I can live with the flaws. Since this is so portable, this is great for mani/pedi parties with your girl/guy friends, or use as a back-up lamp.

title: This BB Cushion is Life
text: So I found out about this product watching Eunice on the WishTrendTV Youtube Channel. My face is fair and very sensitive so I like to use a lot of Korean makeup products since most of them don't have a lot of the harsh chemicals found in most other makeup I have used. I had been using the Triple Function Super BB in Pink(love it!) for awhile now and I how it evens out my skin but it always feels a bit greasy on my skin and sometimes has a bit of shine so I thought I would try something new. Not only is the compact itself attractive but Oh. My. Goodness. I love this so much I can't see how I didn't know about it before. The coverage the sponge provides is great and it leaves such a nice matte finish that makes it look really natural! I wrote this product off as only one application necessary but like any foundation and makeup, if you're going to be eating and drinking it does rub off around the mouth/lip area. Otherwise, only one application is needed! Since my skin is sensitive I was worried but I found this bb-cushion is really light on my face. Doesn't feel heavy, doesn't irritate my skin whatsoever. I still recommend you do a patch test before applying to your face! I follow the face preparation process before applying it. You can find a more in-depth review of products to use and steps at WishTrendTV but basically prepare your face with toner after you completed your face washing routine. I use Wonder Pore toner for this but I would recommend a less watery toner. A toner that kind of has the consistency of essence! Use a cotton pad to apply. And then I apply a vitamin C serum to my face that I pat on with a cotton pad as well. Then apply your sunscreen/lotion but be sure to pat it onto your face. Don't use swiping motions or it'll make the sunscreen kind of cake onto your face. Then last apply the bb-cushion by sponging it on! It looks so good and natural. I would only recommend for skin no darker than beige. Again, love this cushion. I hope you do too!

title: unwieldy upgrade
text:
For years I owned a previous model, the Norelco T860. In fact, I still own it and it works just fine (although it now only holds a charge for about a week). I needed another trimmer for another location, and this one was the upgrade that was available. What a disappointment.

For one thing, it's really big. While the T860 was like a small South American banana, the T780 is like a big North American cucumber. Imagine trying to create an intricate drawing with a child's crayola instead of a pencil.

The extra size is apparently needed for the internal vacuum. This vacuum "works" in that it doesn't let hairs fall to the sink. But they become forever clogged inside the apparatus; you're never going to get them cleaned out, even after opening the flimsy plastic cover. The vacuum also adds to the noise. And my razor doesn't have a vacuum, so I'm going to have to clean up hairs anyway.

The extra girth and the vacuum outlet near the blades means that, as much as I try to cram the thing up under my nose, the blades can't reach the hairs at the top of my upper lip. I have to resort to using the (non-vacuuming) trimmer on my razor, or I'll have two or three long, uncut hairs just under my nose. And the retractable vacuum cover near the blades obscures the view and turns an agile row of blades into an unwieldy block of plastic.

The only benefit of this model is that the battery works well and it uses a nice color scheme.

I wish I knew where to buy another Norelco T860.

Update 2010-09-20: It turns out that the [[ASIN:B002C741MM Philps Norelco QT4021 Stubble Trimmer]] is apparently the upgrade to the Norelco T860, renamed to a "stubble trimmer". Its form is seemingly identical to the T860 and, besides the black/red color and the more grippable rubber coating on the handle, the only major changes seems to be a welcome battery upgrade from a NiCad to a NiMH. The QT4021 is just what I was looking for. I guess I'll drop off the T780 at my parents' house to use as a backup.

text:

I was so excited to test it out so I want to leave some tips because everyone doesn't know how curing works believe it or not. So the lamp works, it is an LED lamp not UV so it's not harmful to your skin. It's cheap so it's a really good deal.
How to Use:
•There are two settings 30 & 60 seconds, press quickly for 30, long press for 60 seconds.
IMPORTANT: DO NOT *TOUCH* THE NAIL POLISH DURING THESE STEPS.
1. Apply thin base coat; cure for 30 seconds.
2. Apply first coat of nail polish, very thin *but* pigmented; cure for 30 seconds.
3. Apply second coat of nail polish, thin; cure for thirty seconds.
4. If needed apply a third coat then cure for thirty seconds.
5. Apply top coat, thick or thin is your choice; cure for 60 seconds.
IMPORTANT: Still don't touch it with your fingers
6. Take a lint free cloth with some alcohol on it and wipe the nail clean.

(These steps were posted previously in a unique manner however I don't think enough people seen their post. Touching the nailpolish will ruin all your efforts. Please trust me.)

title: A Rooftop Solar Panel Charges This Excellent 1.2 V Electric Razor
text:
I switched from Remington to Norelco electric razors over thirty years ago and they just work better, as big a difference in efficiency as comparing the ancient push lawn mower, to today's rotary gasoline and electric lawn mowers.

I especially like this Philips Norelco rechargeable model since, using an available accessory, Norelco model # (e4)020417, a 12 Volt adapter cigarette lighter type extension chord-plug, my 140 Watt solar panels on the roof charge two 6 Volt deep cycle golf cart batteries, wired in series to output 12 volts, then a 12 Volt clamp-on extension chord carries the correct charging voltage through the LED lighted accessory chord to charge the razor for free using sunlight photovoltaics. The same batteries also power my living room hi-fi, using a 12 Volt DC to 120 Volt AC (house current) inverter.

The point, the yearly savings are about $40 total in electric bill costs during the, say, five year life of the razor. The same battery bank also charges about 20 rechargeable D, AA, and AAA rechargeable common batteries using a similar DC power chord with a high quality 12 Volt DC fast charger.

Compared to everyone I know, I pay about a tenth for batteries everyone else does, with much more convenience. Unbeatable razor purchase, especially if solar energy is charging it.

title: My Favorite Cushion
text:
I really like this cushion foundation! It has a natural finish and can hardly be detected. It can actually be customized by if you use it right out of the package with a dewy finish or turn the sponge over for a more matte finish. I was disappointed with the color to be honest. I had heard Korean face makeup was a lot lighter than the ones here in the states but I've found them to just be a tad too dark still for me. This one was actually a lot darker than some of the other ones and much warmer, but I can still get away with it. In all honestly this would be a great foundation then for most people who want to try Korean BB cushions because of the color so I highly recommend! All I did was put in my usual white foundation mixer and now it's perfect.

The cushion case itself is actually the best part and I plan to use it long after the foundation itself is used up.

I took off a star because of the fragrance. I must admit for someone with as sensitive skin as I do I can still wear this without irritation so I still recommend it for people with skin like mine. However, if you're also sensitive to scents as I am, then I wouldn't recommend. It's actually rather light compared to other Korean products that are heavily perfumed, but still has a perfume scent. I'm actually quite disappointed that Korean beauty companies choose to put such fake perfume scents into their products and hinders me from using most. Again, this one is light and gentle enough that even I can use it!

title: Fleeing back to a real razor
text:
For two decades I have fought an uphill battle with a downhill class of products, and I'm throwing in the towel. I've abandoned this electric razor and gone back to a real razor (a basic Gillette Mach 3).

I switched to a multi-headed electric razor over 20 years ago. "Stick with it for 30 days" the instructions implored. Yes, it got better, but never equalled my old 2-blade razor. The convenience suckered me in, and the habit was set. I meticulously cleaned and maintained my electric razors, but never attained a clean shave.

But I stuck with it. Replaced the heads, and that worked for a while, but then same old same old. New electric razors seem to get worse. A little Phillips Philishave 30 worked pretty well (2 heads, *battery* powered), but not great.

When this Arcitec came on board, I said "this is it!" Pricey, but there can be no better, right? Of all the electric razors I have used, I must say that this is the worst. The cleaning system works to a point, but there are inevitably hairs that get lodged in the razor head. And the razor head is effectively *NOT CLEANABLE* except by painstaking surgery to extract lodged hairs.

And the shave? OK, this is not a scientific double-blinded study, but I do honestly believe that this razor provided me with the worst shave of all electric razors I have owned. It got me to jump ship and try a middle-of-the-road Gillette Mach 3. The result ...

HEAVEN! Blades have gotten SO much better since 20 years ago. Super clean shave, no nics, no problems, no irritation ... why did I wait so long??

title: Arcitec 1060
text: First you will need an acetylene  torch and a hacksaw to get through the triple layer plastic sarcophagus that Tutankhamun  would've envied. Wear heavy leather gloves or the plastic will filet your fingers. Once inside you'll find a razor that resembles the missing link in the Praying Mantis lineage. I was skeptical at first seeing it didn't feel all that sturdy like the Braun non-rotary razor I'd been using. However with this razor I found it required only light pressure to cleanly cut short or longer hairs, whereas I've developed tremendous biceps putting adequate pressure on the Braun to get it to cut anything. I tried one day growth and several days growth and the Arcitec cut it with ease. My face also had a nice sheen when I was done, unlike the road rash from the Braun. Cleaning is a little trying to get all the hair out but manageable. The trimmer is purely an afterthought. It is difficult to use. It is awkwardly positioned and too small to be of any real value. The grip is fairly comfortable except if you have large hands, as I do, then your fingers will start lapping each other, but I digress. Overall it is a very good razor. It conforms to your face nicely and manages difficult curves and tight spots easily. That's what I like most about it.

I have dry skin, semi sensitive and this is soothing feeling as well as non irritating. The combo of Centella Asiatica (soothing, skin health) and Hyaluronic Acid (retaining moisture) are the clear winning ingredients in this awesome oil cleanser.

I dab this oil cleanser all over the face, then let the heat of my hands melt it into my skin. It quickly turns to a spreadable oil to massage in all over. I really like the solid balm to oils over the liquid oils as I find them easier to work with. They also seem to rinse away cleaner? I feel like I could use this Mizon oil balm as my only cleansing step, but I am rather used to doing a 2nd cleanse with a gentle cleanser to wash off any remaining dissolved gunk from the first wash. You'll have to try it out for yourself.

Currently using this gentle, clean, vegan cleanser by To Do List as my second cleanse after Mizon:
https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B08NDJR7S4

I have a couple of double duty balm-to- oil cleansers that I like, and I would consider Mizon Cicaluronic as a repurchase.

title: I LOVE this Little Machine!
text:
I have over 200 bottles of regular nail polish, more than 30 gel polishes and about 40 stamping polishes. I really wanted to try a lacquer shaker to help my polishes to apply more smoothly and last longer, but they were all so expensive until this one came out. I finally felt like I could afford to try out a polish shaker without breaking the bank. Here are some of the finer points about this shaker:

It has been able to shake EVERY shape and type of bottle that I've used it for. This includes round bottles, square bottles, tiny MDU mini bottles, etc. Everything. The strap has holes on both sides -- don't forget this when you're trying to fit a small or irregular shaped bottle.

My bottles are secure. I feel safe letting them shake in that machine -- I do not fear that they will jump out and shatter.

It does the job it's supposed to! There are some super thick stamping polishes (MDU) that I still have to add steel mixing balls to, but anyone who has that type of polish knows that it's particularly difficult to mix up.

Add a few drops of lacquer thinner (NOT nail polish remover!) to an older/thicker polish and shake it up for 30 seconds and your polish will be good as new.

Get the last drops of polish out of a bottle by shaking it up before use.

I also love that this is powered, so you don't have to use batteries at all.

I have used the heck out of mine (I make nail polish jewelry) and it still works perfectly. I love this little machine!

Cons:
It's loud, but I don't expect anything else out of that type of machine

title: Not perfect, but nothing is.
text:
It's attractive, it works smoothly, it chomps through my relatively light stubble in a hurry, it holds a charge for more than a week at a time... basically it's just solid and works.

The drawbacks:

1) It doesn't fully and completely get all the wispy hairs on my neck down to skin level, but then I've never found an electric razor that did. You can't really see them, and if I want to look super extra spiffy some day, I have a fixed-blade mach 5 that takes them out in a minute and a half... And because that razor only gets used occasionally and on the very light / sparse hair that the Norelco leaves behind, the shave is very easy to do, friendly to my skin, and its blades are basically lasting forever.

2) The charger plugs into its base and its carrying case (which is a nifty one, BTW), not the razor itself. So you can't use it while charging. In the event you ran completely out of power, this would be a problem... Though not an enormous one, as the battery lasts a long long time, has an indicator that tells you where it's at so you don't get surprised, and in the worst case scenario it charges really very fast (maybe an hour). Plus, I guess, in an absolute emergency I have the fixed-blade razor that isn't as convenient, but can do the job in a pinch.

title: Wow!!!  It's perfect!🥰
text:
Wow! I just tried it for the very first time, and I was careful to follow the instructions. First I did my routine facial care, (cleaner and moisturizer.) I made sure the moisturizer was fully absorbed.
I took the mushroom sponge, stamped it gently on the make up, (*you won't see a lot of makeup on the sponge.) Then I gently stamped it on my face in an upward direction (like counter clockwise, and you blend gently as you go, to connect the stamps!) As I was applying it, it was too good to be true, because it was exactly as how it's advertised. I have rosacea, visible pores on my nose, reddened skin on my chin, visible nasolabial lines which make my lower face look so droopy, crows feet, and a faint line between my eyes. I also have undereye circles, which I've tried so many concealers and it makes them even darker...I look like I have 2 black eyes! I did the left side of my face. As I was applying it, the flaws began to disappear. Afterwards I just stood there looking in the mirror shocked! No redness, my nasolabial folds were at least 50% better and smoother, making them a lot less noticeable! My entire face looked uplifted instead of droopy. Fine lines around eyes...what fine lines? There are none now! And finally: my dark circles drastically improved, this makeup actually "concealed" them, and didn't cake up in some fine lines below my lower lids. I am still shocked! I'm so amazed, and so happy that I've finally found a makeup that does it all! My skin looks smooth, flawless, even-toned and pretty.
Buy this!

title: Poor Performer
text: I've been using this product for the past handful of months and I'm just consistently disappointed at the shave time length. I'm a weekly shaver and so I let it grow to a significant length and I'm finding that this razor more often than not misses many splotchy patches of hair and invariably leaves these singular hairs that I just have to break down and pull out the clippers to shave off a bit before I hit it with the blades hoping that they will finally catch and remove the hair. My shave time has just about doubled using this clumsy device, its slow and it leaves a mess all over the counter. Those catch regions behind the blades they're pretty pathetic for shaving beard lengths on the order of a week. I always have fall off all over the region of my sink under my chin, and the trimmings are all over my hands too, it's annoying. This product is way too expensive for this kind of performance. This model was supposed to be an upgrade from this very basic Norelco model I had with single blade tracks, but even that one did a quicker job albeit with a bit more razor burn, but at least I could impress it into my skin to force a closer shave. This model won't let you do anything comparable because the pressure will just get wasted in the pivoting head mechanism. I'm overall dissatisfied with this product and I wish instead I bought that Braun razor instead that I was comparing this to.
